title: First-Game Hit Probability
scenario: For every studio, calculate the percentage of total studio revenue/score generated by their very first released game.
tableSchema: developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT), ratings (game_id INT, user_score NUMERIC), games (game_id INT, release_year INT)
hint: Rank games by release_year per studio.
correctQuery: SELECT studio_name, (first_score * 100.0 / total_studio_score) as pct_from_first FROM (SELECT studio_name, SUM(user_score) as total_studio_score, MAX(CASE WHEN rnk = 1 THEN user_score END) as first_score FROM (SELECT d.studio_name, r.user_score, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY d.studio_name ORDER BY g.release_year) as rnk FROM developers d JOIN ratings r ON d.game_id = r.game_id JOIN games g ON d.game_id = g.game_id) t GROUP BY studio_name) t2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE developers (studio_name VARCHAR, game_id INT); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, user_score NUMERIC); CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, release_year INT);
